hints.title: Required Character Frequencies
hints.text: Rearranging to form 'leet' requires at least one 'l', at least two 'e's, and at least one 't'.

hints.title: Complementary Counting
hints.text: Count strings that violate at least one requirement and subtract from total 26^n strings.

hints.title: Inclusion-Exclusion Terms
hints.text: Compute powers of 25, 24, and 23 with linear term n * base^(n-1) accounting for zero or one 'e'.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def stringCount(self, n: int) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        if n < 4:
            return 0
        total = pow(26, n, MOD)
        not_l = pow(25, n, MOD)
        not_t = pow(25, n, MOD)
        few_e = (pow(25, n, MOD) + n * pow(25, n - 1, MOD)) % MOD
        not_lt = pow(24, n, MOD)
        not_le = (pow(24, n, MOD) + n * pow(24, n - 1, MOD)) % MOD
        not_te = (pow(24, n, MOD) + n * pow(24, n - 1, MOD)) % MOD
        not_lte = (pow(23, n, MOD) + n * pow(23, n - 1, MOD)) % MOD
        invalid = (not_l + not_t + few_e - not_lt - not_le - not_te + not_lte) % MOD
        return (total - invalid + MOD) % MOD
```

complexity.notes: Fast modular exponentiation for combinatorial formula.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining 26^n strings is impossible for n up to 10^5.
